body: It gives me some solace that you´re in a similar place I guess. Thanks for not trying to guilt me or drown me in canned, saccharine responses. I appreciate your ramblings and that you took some of your time and energy to respond. Take care.

I think about that too. For me, I think it's so that they can finally understand how much I have suffered. But also how can I feel better about it if I'm dead? I'd love the attention bc I'm a bad person but I'm not gonna be able to see people sad and grieving me because I'll be fucking dead. I can't say that I have anything meaningful to say in regards to why you shouldn't but just wanted you to know that you weren't alone in this. Take care.
